figure_note: Raw native RGB crops in columns 1/2. Column 3 blends only the zero-step normal geom-ID map over its RGB and projects the paper and print edges. Column 4 hides hand and both fingers.

methods.alignment: Report global RGB changes, common-depth P99 and valid-mask disagreement, symmetric Canny distances within each paper bounding rectangle plus 5 px, same frozen/normal marker decisions. Eligibility uses inherited camera/FK limits, the same observed/usable ID set and local p95 edge deviation <=0.5 px in both directions. Count individually aligned named foreground where source/render RGB differ by at most 2/255 per channel and source/raw-render depth by at most 5 mm.
methods.areas: 6x6 including the 1-cell black border surrounding the 4x4 payload. Quiet is paper minus print. Paper/print edges use +/-1.5 px measured perpendicular to each finite segment, sides +Y,+X,-Y,-X in marker coordinates. Corner order (-X,+Y), (+X,+Y), (+X,-Y), (-X,-Y); each samples a 3x3 patch centered on its nearest integer pixel. Outside shells use Euclidean distance to the polygon, excluding its interior. Edge/corner statistics overlap and are not additive.
methods.attribution: A recovered ID plus aligned named foreground in print or quiet supports a local foreground contribution; the contact pixel need not be the sole cause. Recovery with zero paper foreground demonstrates a hand/finger appearance effect but does not distinguish shadows, antialiasing and adjacent contour grouping. Each singleton hides only that named geom. An individual ID may be usable even when the dual arbitration refuses the frame.
methods.coordinate_rule: Integer pixel centers. Project the actual 100 mm quiet substrate top and 75 mm printed top from frozen object pose, corresponding object-to-marker registration and checked compiled geoms. Ink sits 0.020 mm above quiet substrate.
methods.foreground: Positive original optical-Z pixels more than 5 or 20 mm closer than their predicted print (inside print) or quiet (elsewhere) plane. Individual proportions divide by the positive depths of that area.
methods.noise: Paired metric depth = frozen depth + (hidden clean depth - normal clean depth) on common valid rays; depth perturbation is identical on unchanged surfaces. Newly visible rays lacking a positive source/normal depth take the clean hidden depth. Thus the local measured residual, including rendering mismatch, is transported. Clean decisions are also reported independently. Render times/frame IDs are diagnostic.
methods.original_modalities: Frozen packets carry native RGB, optical_z_m and a valid mask. Registered pixel-index rows bind only these RGB-D files; the originals manifest has no per-frame geom/segmentation sidecar. Named geom values are from the zero-step reconstruction only.
methods.pose: Restore seven arm joint and two finger positions/velocities, object free pose/velocity and time via mj_forward. No backend, integration, or commands. Unrecorded actuator/solver internal state is not needed for drawing; only visible kinematics and calibration are verified.
